[IDSP.1.3] **Error stash, not return.** The Rete eval path
runs an action for its side effects and discards the result
value, so a verb's `ds_result_t` cannot return up the eval
stack. Essential-verb failures — and unregistered essential
callbacks — are stashed on the engine pending slot via
`ds_engine_set_pending`; `ds_engine_pump`
drains it with `ds_engine_take_pending` after `ds_rete_run`
and returns the first error to its caller. Observational
verbs (log) deliberately do not stash — their
failure leaves the pump `DS_OK`.
